# Junda Smells
Standard host and service health for **rha75589**. Built from `dashboards/junda-smells/` in the Isatec-RHA-SaaS repo.

2.title: Avg CPU %
2.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage)
| fields `Avg CPU %` = arrayAvg(cpu)

3.title: Avg memory %
3.query:
timeseries mem = avg(dt.host.memory.usage)
| fields `Avg memory %` = arrayAvg(mem)

4.title: Service requests
4.query:
timeseries req = sum(dt.service.request.count)
| fields Requests = arraySum(req)

5.title: Failure rate %
5.query:
timeseries { req = sum(dt.service.request.count), fail = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count) }
| fields `Failure rate %` = 100 * arraySum(fail) / arraySum(req)
